name: Hive Publish Developer API
description: Scoped programmatic access to the same safe organic-social tools exposed through the Hive Publish MCP server. Hive Publish automates DMs on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and Telegram, publishes to twelve networks, answers everything in one inbox and reports on all of it. Free for 14 days with no card, then $6 per connected account per month on Worker Bee, $12 on Swarm, or $85 a month flat on Queen Bee. Priced per connected account, never per contact. Prices: https://hivepublish.com/pricing.json
